title: Lilla Lumi och månens glittrande stig
sharedPrompt: Original soft hand-painted 2D Nordic children's-book illustration for ages 3–5; calm navy, turquoise, lavender and warm silver-white night palette; rounded clean silhouettes; low visual stress; no text, logo, watermark, border, photorealism or glossy 3D plastic. Keep the lower-left area calm for the story text UI.

characterBible.Lumi: Small round white baby seal, warm dark eyes, tiny charcoal nose, short whiskers, small rounded flippers, subtle blue-grey fur shadows, no clothes or accessories.
characterBible.MotherSeal: Larger pearl-white seal of the same species, calm protective face and posture.
characterBible.BlueFish: Small rounded turquoise-blue fish, darker soft fins, large calm eyes and friendly face.
characterBible.SeaTurtle: Old friendly rounded turtle in muted green and turquoise with calm wise eyes.
characterBible.Seagull: Small sleepy rounded white-and-soft-grey gull with a pale beak and gentle half-lidded eyes.

assets.scenePrompt: Lumi rests snugly beside Mother Seal on a smooth sea rock; a full moon creates a long silver path over a nearly still night sea.
Lumi plays with translucent bubbles and a tail splash at dusk while Mother watches safely from the rock.
Lumi lies at the rock edge and watches the full moon light a long silver path across the water.
Lumi asks Mother Seal about the moon path while they rest close together on the rock.
Lumi slips into the sea and swims along the silver path while Mother remains visible behind.
Underwater, Lumi finds the small blue fish behind a rounded stone among soft sea grass and bubbles.
Lumi and the blue fish swim side by side under a broad ribbon of moonlight.
The old friendly sea turtle rests in sea grass while Lumi and the fish listen.
The turtle points toward the softest, warmer ribbon of moonlight as Lumi and the fish look on.
A wide sleepy sea view with Lumi and the fish small but clear in the moon path.
The blue fish rejoins its friendly family in a warm glowing coral cave while Lumi watches.
A small wooden boat with lowered sail and warm lantern rocks beside Lumi; a sleepy gull yawns on its edge.
Closer view of Lumi and the sleepy gull; the moon path continues toward a natural distant rock, with no buildings.
Lumi looks back to Mother waiting in silver moonlight; the moon path binds them together.
A sleepy Lumi swims home along the quiet silver path toward the familiar rock.
Mother helps Lumi onto the rock and wraps a protective flipper around her.
Lumi sleeps under Mother's flipper while faint dream memories of the fish, turtle and boat shimmer in moonlight.

discardedGeneration.reason: The first page 12 attempt introduced a lighthouse and houses; it was not copied into the project.
